summary: Cherokee County, TX: FFLA index lists Rusk Loc 1 and Loc 2 as gone; Forest Lookouts quotes a 1939 Tower No. 9, 1946 patrol use and a 1993 sale notice.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index marks Rusk (Loc 1) and Rusk (Loc 2) Gone; the sources do not match the 1939 Tower No. 9 to either location

staffing.status: patrolman J. Layton Jones handled fires from the Rusk lookout tower in 1946; no later staffing reported

events.note: June 1939 Rusk Cherokeean item, quoted by Forest Lookouts, calls the tower Tower No. 9 and places it 1 1/2 miles northwest of Rusk
Forest Patrolman J. Layton Jones handled fires from the Rusk lookout tower in January and March 1946

Texas Forest Service notice in the Tyler Morning Telegraph (January 15, 1993) seeks sealed bids for the sale, dismantling and removal of its fire towers, naming the Rusk Fire Lookout Tower; bids due February 23, 1993
Index marks Rusk (Loc 1) and Rusk (Loc 2) as Gone; no date or method given

evidence.supports: Index lists Rusk (Loc 1) in Cherokee County at 31.81696, -95.16485 as Tower Gone
Index lists Rusk (Loc 2) in Cherokee County at 31.80444, -95.11667 as Tower Gone
Forest Lookouts file the Rusk tower under Cherokee County and the Texas Forest Service
Forest Lookouts page is headed RUSK #9
June 1939 item calls the tower Tower No. 9 and places it 1 1/2 miles northwest of Rusk
evidence.quote: Tower No. 9, Rusk, 1 1/2 miles northwest of Rusk.

evidence.supports: Patrolman J. Layton Jones handled three fires from the Rusk lookout tower in January 1946
evidence.quote: Three fires were handled by Forest Patrolman J. Layton Jones at the Rusk lookout tower

evidence.supports: There were 34 forest fires in March 1946
evidence.quote: There were during March 34 forest fires

evidence.supports: Patrolman J. Layton Jones handled fourteen of the March 1946 fires from the Rusk lookout tower
evidence.quote: Forest patrolman J. Layton Jones of the Rusk lookout tower handled fourteen of the fires.

evidence.supports: Notice dated January 15, 1993 (Tyler Morning Telegraph) of sealed bids for the sale, dismantling and removal of Texas Forest Service fire towers
evidence.quote: Sealed bids for the sale, dismantling and removal of fire lookout towers owned by the Texas Forest Service

evidence.supports: Notice lists the Rusk Fire Lookout Tower in Cherokee County among towers to be sold
evidence.quote: Fire lookout towers to be sold include: Rusk Fire Lookout Tower, Cherokee County.

evidence.supports: Bids were due by 9:30 a.m. on Tuesday, February 23, 1993
evidence.quote: will be received until 9:30 A.M., Tuesday February 23, 1993

notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts Rusk page is a set of newspaper quotations (Rusk Cherokeean 1939 and 1946; Tyler Morning Telegraph 1993) without page numbers, and the originals were not checked. The sources do not tie Loc 1 or Loc 2 to Tower No. 9, so the story says the match is unknown. The 1993 notice announces a sale; no source confirms the tower was sold, dismantled or removed. The index entries for Loc 1 and Loc 2 carry no dates. Brief record check: name, county, coordinates and gone status for Loc 1 match the index; no correction proposed. Next steps if pursued: the Cherokeean 1946 and 1993 pages on the Portal to Texas History (texashistory.unt.edu) for the sale outcome and tower location.
